shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la && echo "--- current" && find current -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null && echo "--- proposed" && find proposed -maxdepth 3 -not -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null && echo "--- out" && ls -la out 2>/dev/null

cat proposed/CHANGES.txt && echo "--- current/RELEASE.txt" && cat current/RELEASE.txt && echo "--- diffs" && for f in app.json logging.json database.json limits.properties features.properties; do echo "=== $f"; diff -u current/$f proposed/$f; done; echo "=== cache.json (proposed only)"; cat proposed

cat proposed/CHANGES.txt && echo "--- current/RELEASE.txt" && cat current/RELEASE.txt && echo "--- diff app.json" && diff -u current/app.json proposed/app.json; echo "--- diff logging.json" && diff -u current/logging.json proposed/logging.json; echo "--- diff database.json" && diff -u current/databa
